```yaml
name: Replay Benchmark

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Weekly at midnight on Sunday
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run environment checks
        run: python check_env.py --auto-install

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        run: pre-commit run --files README.md .github/workflows/bench.yml docs/bench_history.csv scripts/run_replay_bench.py

  benchmark:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run replay benchmark
        run: python scripts/run_replay_bench.py

      - name: Upload benchmark results
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/upload-benchmark-results@main
        with:
          benchmark-results-dir: 'results'
          benchmark-name: 'replay_benchmark'
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          venv: 'venv'

  notify:
    needs: [setup, benchmark]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Notify via PostHog
        uses: PostHog/posthog-github-action@eea1405eeb2d1d2259f0ee0b44d7b152869e6840
        with:
          posthog-token: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_TOKEN }}
          event: 'Replay Benchmark Completed'
          properties: '{"status": "success"}'
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  commit_changes:
    needs: [setup, benchmark, notify]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Commit and push changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
        with:
          commit_message: 'Update benchmark results'
          branch: main
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
